svg.title: Extreme color seeds: endpoint and interior placement comparison
svg.desc: Near-white and near-black seeds shown with Auto endpoint placement and manual step 500 placement. Interior placement compresses raw lightness steps and repeats some displayed HEX values. Exact white and black have one endpoint row each; interior placement is blocked in this proposal. S marks the seed; equals marks a HEX matching the previous displayed step.
svg.text: Extreme seeds: endpoint placement or a compressed interior?
Neutral, opaque examples isolate lightness. Same exact seed; different placement and endpoint rules.
S = seed anchor = after a step label = same displayed HEX as the previous step L = actual endpoints, rounded
Auto: 11 distinct HEX values. Interior: 8. Steps 50/100/200 repeat #fcfcfc; 300/400 repeat #fbfbfb.
Interior upper endpoint becomes (1 + seed L) / 2 = .99255; there is very little lightness left above the seed.
Auto: 11 distinct HEX values. Interior: 9. Steps 700/800/900 all display #010101.
Interior lower endpoint becomes seed L / 2 = .04846. Its positive raw L still rounds to #000000 in HEX.
Interior 500: blocked in this proposal — exact white has no lighter values. No generated row is shown.
Interior 500: blocked in this proposal — exact black has no darker values. No generated row is shown.
Raw OKLCH lightness remains strictly descending. Different raw values can round to the same 8-bit sRGB HEX.
The = marker reports exact displayed duplicates only; no perceptual distinguishability threshold is selected.
Defaults are L .97 / .20. An endpoint seed replaces that endpoint. Auto and adjustment rules remain exploratory.
Final rows are neutral; a preliminary #040404 conversion anomaly is recorded in the report and remains unqualified.
Exploration · 21 November 2026 · 11 steps · No chromatic-extreme, alpha or production-policy validation.
